name: WorldMonitorAIO-Unofficial
description: Unofficial all-in-one self-hosted World Monitor global intelligence dashboard with its local API, private Valkey cache, optional AIS relay, and scheduled data seeders.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Generated internal secrets, Valkey data, and seeder state. Use a dedicated directory.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: World Monitor HTTP interface. Change the host port if 3300 is already in use.

variables.name: Seed on startup
variables.description: Run the upstream data seeders after startup.

variables.name: Seed interval minutes
variables.description: Minutes between seed passes. Set to 0 to disable recurring seeding.

variables.name: Per-seeder timeout seconds
variables.description: Maximum runtime for eligible individual seeders. Set to 0 to disable the outer timeout.

variables.name: Redis memory limit
variables.description: Maximum Redis cache memory inside the container.

variables.name: AISStream API key
variables.description: Optional live AIS vessel tracking.

variables.name: OpenSky client ID
variables.description: Optional OpenSky OAuth client ID for authenticated military flight data.

variables.name: OpenSky client secret
variables.description: Optional OpenSky OAuth client secret for authenticated military flight data.

variables.name: NASA FIRMS API key
variables.description: Optional NASA FIRMS wildfire data.

variables.name: Finnhub API key
variables.description: Optional market data.

variables.name: FRED API key
variables.description: Optional Federal Reserve economic data.

variables.name: EIA API key
variables.description: Optional US energy data.

variables.name: Aviationstack API key
variables.description: Optional aviation data.

variables.name: Travelpayouts API token
variables.description: Optional travel and flight data.

variables.name: Cloudflare API token
variables.description: Optional Cloudflare Radar data; account access may be restricted or paid.

variables.name: ACLED access token
variables.description: Optional ACLED conflict data token.

variables.name: ACLED email
variables.description: Optional ACLED account email when required by the upstream API.

variables.name: ACLED password
variables.description: Optional ACLED account password when required by the upstream API.

variables.name: Groq API key
variables.description: Optional Groq-backed AI summaries.

variables.name: OpenRouter API key
variables.description: Optional OpenRouter-backed AI summaries.

variables.name: LLM API URL
variables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL.

variables.name: LLM API key
variables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint key.

variables.name: LLM model
variables.description: Optional model name for the compatible endpoint.

variables.name: Ollama API URL
variables.description: Preferred OpenAI-compatible Ollama endpoint URL used by the seeders.

variables.name: Ollama API key
variables.description: Optional authentication key for the Ollama-compatible endpoint.

variables.name: Ollama model
variables.description: Model name used by the Ollama-compatible endpoint.
